name: stock_receipt
description: GH #3749 / REQ-712, docs/assets/stock-workflow-documents.md sections 1.4 and 9.1, decision 0078 D5. The header of a stock receipt document. It is written only by module stock (managed type). document_id is the id of the versioned document of Letflow.Documents (decision 0056) that carries the state, the gap-free number and the issued time: no number, status, posted_at, posted_by or reversed_by_entry is stored here (they are read from the versioned document). org_unit_id is the issuing org unit (queried; the scope column of decision 0076 R7). event_time is the time of the receipt, ISO 8601 with offset, stored in UTC. location_id, responsible_id and counterparty_id are record ids of modules locations, org and catalog_items (other packs: no foreign key; the module checks them at issue). After issue nothing of the header changes.
